purpose: Teach: コロコロ/サブタイトル/タイツ/トラバ/スバ/ジモン/背番号/ケタ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、コロコロコミック読んでたな
lines.en: Riku, you were reading Koro-Koro Comic the whole time.
lines.style: Teasing observation delivered with slight smirk. Casual, knowing tone. The confidence of someone calling out a friend's secret habit. Light and not unkind.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、映画のサブタイトル覚えるの上手だな、桜
lines.en: Oh, you're good at remembering movie subtitles, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine compliment wrapped in mock-seriousness. Slight pause before delivery, like he's turning her own teasing back on her. Softer than his usual cool distance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、冬にタイツ重ね履きしてたな
lines.en: Riku, you wore layered tights all winter, didn't you.
lines.style: Rapid-fire observation, barely suppressing amusement. Matter-of-fact delivery that makes the detail absurd. The rhythm of someone enjoying their own joke.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ブログのトラバ、つまりトラックバック付けてたろ、桜
lines.en: You were leaving trackbacks on blogs—you know, actual trackbacks—weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate setup. Leans into the outdated reference with dry precision. Watching her face. Light rhythm that builds to the punchline.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でフィジー首都スバ覚えたろ
lines.en: Riku, you memorized Fiji's capital, Suva, for social studies class, didn't you.
lines.style: Switching to genuine curiosity mid-teasing. The cadence straightens slightly. Still playful but with real interest underneath—testing whether he'll bite.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、寺門ジモンのファンだったろ、桜
lines.en: You were a fan of Teramon Jimon, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Matching her energy shift. The wry tone returns but with less edge. Comfortable now. Like they're both remembering something they don't need to pretend about.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、サッカー部で背番号7だったろ
lines.en: Riku, you wore number seven on the soccer team, didn't you.
lines.style: The tone opens slightly—less teasing, more actual interest. Straightforward question with a hint of respect underneath. Watching to see if he'll admit it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト結果がケタ違いに上がったな、桜
lines.en: Your test scores jumped dramatically, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine praise delivered quietly. No sarcasm now. The kind of observation that comes from actually noticing. Warm, direct, and slightly vulnerable for admitting he saw.
